openingSummary.zh: 隔夜 AI 圈的主线依然是「更便宜、更长的上下文、更自主的 Agent」：开源社区放出新的 MoE 权重把推理成本再压一档；长上下文复现工作提醒大家显存账本别只看论文里的理想值；具身方向有新 demo 展示端到端导航的可靠性提升。产品侧，多家助手类工具都把「多步工作流固化」作为本轮更新的关键词。以下为编辑整理的要点速览。
openingSummary.en: Overnight, the AI world stayed on three rails — cheaper, longer, more autonomous: the open-source community shipped a new MoE checkpoint pushing inference cost down again; a long-context replication effort reminded everyone that real VRAM bills exceed paper claims; and embodied agents demoed sturdier end-to-end navigation. On the product side, several assistants converged on "turning multi-step workflows into reusable skills" as this cycle's keyword. Below is our edited digest.

summary.zh: 开源社区放出新的 70B 级 MoE 权重：推理成本再降一档，评测脚本与权重已在 Hugging Face 同步上线。
summary.en: A new 70B-class MoE checkpoint just dropped: another notch down on inference cost, with eval scripts and weights already on Hugging Face.

summary.en: We replicated a 1M-token long-context paper: measured VRAM use is ~1.8x the reported figure — open-source profiler linked.
